title: Steady Climb
briefing: Same market, same news, every player. Orchard Foods and Kestrel Air are both climbing. One scary headline will test everyone's nerve.
objective: Hold a good trend through short-lived bad news; do not sell the dip on a headline.
debrief: Both stocks climbed for most of the match. The fuel-price headline on day 11 knocked Kestrel Air down for two days, and players who sold it there bought back higher or missed the rest of the climb. A disciplined player invested early, kept a sensible stop below the trend rather than a hair-trigger one, and held through the noise.
